svg.desc: How does a checked population support a conclusion? Invoice headers: January–March 2024; One row per invoice; SubTotal before freight / tax. Monthly summary: Count invoices; Sum SubTotal by month; Credits are outside this measure. Evidence memo: Describe the observed change; Check scope and totals; Ask what explains the change
